jobDescription: Lead Software Engineer on the FSE+ platform, making architecture and tooling decisions and defining technical roadmaps alongside hands-on development.
mainTasks: Make architecture and tooling decisions and define the technical roadmap.
Design and develop core project components, support other developers, and mentor them in their technical development.
Standardize development environments with WSL and automate deployments and configuration with Ansible.
Define infrastructure as code with Terraform for OpenStack environments.
Lead major Java, Spring Boot, OpenSearch, and PostgreSQL upgrades, addressing compatibility and keeping the technology stack current.
Configure Renovate to manage minor and major dependency updates, helping the team address technical debt earlier.
Use an existing agent platform to set up automation for ticket triage, bug fixing, and end-to-end test generation.

jobDescription: Developed backend and frontend modules for the FSE+ platform, with a focus on delivery reliability and code quality.
mainTasks: Designed and developed features across multiple backend and frontend modules.
Modernized CI/CD pipelines to improve build reliability and delivery speed.
Migrated integration tests to Testcontainers on the first project in the business unit to adopt it. Other projects followed with support from the business unit technical leader.
Contributed through code reviews, refactoring, and architectural improvements.

jobDescription: Built microservices and platform capabilities for the luxury-goods sector as a consultant through SQLI.
mainTasks: Designed and developed features and created several microservices from scratch.
Implemented composite mode in Spring Cloud Config Server to support configuration from multiple sources.
Added configuration hot reload across the microservices platform, enabling updates without redeployment.

jobDescription: Developed a white-label open-banking platform exposing PSD2 APIs to third-party providers under the Berlin Group standard and integrating with banks’ core banking systems.
mainTasks: Developed connectors to core banking systems and bank-specific integrations for account and transaction information, payment initiation, and confirmation of funds availability.
Contributed to enhancements of the shared white-label product.
Investigated and resolved production incidents.

jobDescription: Developed a platform for an operator providing parking enforcement services to municipalities.
mainTasks: Designed and developed Java/Spring microservices, including data models, API contracts, and communication between services.
Developed connectors to Parkeon/Flowbird parking systems following French parking industry federation (FNMS) API specifications, including checks of parking payments.
Used PostgreSQL/PostGIS for geospatial data.
Wrote tests, participated in deployments, and resolved production incidents.
Maintained and improved CI/CD pipelines.
